Cae_Tweaks v19 updated 2026-06-16 (UTC+0)  Terms of Use MIT License: https://opensource.org/licenses/mit-license.html  Description The plugin file must be named Cae_Tweaks.js.  This plugin contains a bunch of different things. It's mostly just me slowly making a game and coding some more stuff...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
Probably many more, I just found the first two with a quick search~
(I've noticed that many MZ plugins for adding/removing commands often don't adjust the height of the corresponding window, which can cause scrolling or empty space. But if you're basically replacing "Options" with "Quit" then the total number of commands remains the same, so that's not a problem.)
